metaTitle: Valorant Stats & Rank Command for Twitch - ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Free Valorant rank command for Twitch chat. !valrank shows rank and RR, !valmatches lists recent competitive games, !valshop shows the daily store. Part of ItsBagelBot, free forever.
title: Your rank, asked and answered.
lead: Viewers type !valrank and chat sees your rank, RR and recent games. No alt-tab, no overlay.
howTitle: Turn it on once, answer forever.
step1Desc: Valorant stats are an opt-in module: switch it on from the dashboard and link the Riot ID it should answer for.
step2Desc: Anyone can type the commands; per-command cooldowns keep busy chats from spamming them.
step3Desc: Stats are fetched on demand from public Valorant data services and cached briefly, so answers stay fast even mid-raid. Nothing runs on the gaming PC.
cmd6Desc: The catch-all: one command, subcommands for everything above.
limitsNote: The module is opt-in per channel and every command carries a cooldown.
faqQ1: How do I show my Valorant rank in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable the Valorant module from the ItsBagelBot dashboard, link your Riot ID, and viewers can type !valrank in chat. The bot answers with your current rank and RR.
faqQ2: Does it need an overlay or anything on my gaming PC?
faqA2: No. It is a chat command. The bot fetches stats from public Valorant data services on its own servers; nothing is installed or captured on your machine.
faqA3: Yes. Game stats are part of the free tier, forever. Premium only buys message priority, never features.
faqQ4: Can I keep chat from spamming it?
faqA4: Every command has a cooldown, and the whole module is opt-in, so it only answers in channels that turned it on.
ctaTitle: Let chat check the rank themselves.
